item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 20/Jun/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The subtropical ridge will bring persistently very hot and generally fine weather to Guangdong in the next couple of days. A broad trough of low pressure is expected to affect the central and northern parts of the South China Sea over the weekend and will edge closer to the coast of southern China early next week. There will be thunderstorms and more showers over the region.
